Nova.title: Policy Intelligence Specialist
Nova.desc: Acquires and analyzes policy information from industrial, university and internet policy databases, adapting them to individual backgrounds.

Nexus.title: Industry-Research Transfer Specialist
Nexus.desc: A bridge between research and industry. Analyzes industrial value, recommends matching research teams, and generates transfer reports.

Bob.title: Scheduling Assistant
Bob.desc: Automatically extracts meeting intents from context and generates standard .ics calendar invites. Supports smart time inference and multiple timezones.

Iris.title: Web Designer
Iris.desc: Focuses on marketing page design. Generates exquisite multi-page marketing websites based on brand positioning.

Atlas.title: Research Resource Specialist
Atlas.desc: Retrieves instruments, consumables, and reagents from research databases, cross-references suppliers, and generates selection reports.

Eric.title: Legal & Compliance Officer
Eric.desc: Pulls standard contract templates and automatically fills variables based on latest terms to generate service agreements, NDAs, MOUs, etc.

David.title: Internal Audit Specialist
David.desc: Reviews historical communications to identify business loopholes, unfulfilled promises, and process defects, generating internal rectification tickets.

Hugo.title: Financial Analyst
Hugo.desc: Focuses on financial data analysis, including financial statements, budgeting, ROI, cost optimization, and breakeven analysis.

Jarvis.title: Talent Intelligence Specialist
Jarvis.desc: Uses ORCID, Google Scholar, Wikipedia, and more to perform deep retrieval, cross-validation, and academic profiling of scholars.

Alice.title: Proposal Architect
Alice.desc: Quickly generates structured business proposals, project plans, and solution architecture documents based on customer needs.

Kelly.title: Document Processing Specialist
Kelly.desc: Processes uploaded files: translates documents, fills forms, extracts key data, converts formats, and summarizes information.

Edda.title: Presentation Specialist
Edda.desc: Automatically extracts outline structures from text and generates physical .pptx presentations. Supports theme customization.

Fiona.title: Communications Specialist
Fiona.desc: Pushes core decisions and action items to absentees, writes internal memos, and ensures information continuity.

Grace.title: Email Dispatch Specialist
Grace.desc: Final step specialist. Waits for other AI outputs, drafts formal emails, and sends them out with all attachments.

Chief.title: Orchestrator
Chief.desc: Global commander. Parses raw input, extracts semantic intent, dynamically generates task pipelines, and dispatches subtasks.
